blocks.text: Revelation uses Balaam as a comparison for teaching it condemns in Pergamum. This is a later biblical reuse of the Balaam tradition, so it should be read in light of Revelation’s own argument rather than treated as identical to the way Numbers addresses Balaam in its Torah setting.

Across Revelation, the book repeatedly reworks Israel’s Scriptures. At the same time, the available evidence does not establish one continuous, empire-wide persecution program as the setting behind all seven messages. The pressures named in individual messages should therefore not automatically be made into a single uniform situation.
